verdict: Fiserv booked a $5.9B loss because it wrote down $6.5B of goodwill — a non-cash charge; the underlying business earned an adjusted $1.75 a share on revenue that slipped 1%.

segments.name: Merchant Solutions
segments.note: Payments acceptance for merchants, including Clover point-of-sale systems — GAAP revenue fell 3%; organic revenue fell 2%.

segments.name: Financial Solutions
segments.note: Technology for banks and credit unions — flat as reported; organic revenue returned to growth, up 2%.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.note: Almost entirely postage reimbursements passed through for clients — it washes out against costs and is excluded from Fiserv's adjusted revenue.

opex.name: Goodwill impairment
opex.note: A non-cash write-down of goodwill in Corporate and Other — an admission that businesses Fiserv bought in the past are worth less than it paid.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: SG&A of $1,901M, partly offset by a $102M net gain on selling businesses and other assets — shown net so the chart foots to the reported operating loss.

otherDetail: Interest expense, net of $333M, partly offset by a $29M gain on early debt extinguishment, plus $4M of other expense — a net $308M drag.
footerNote: Chart note: the $6.5B goodwill impairment pushed running costs far above gross profit, and interest and tax added more, so the chart draws the $5.9B net loss as a 'Covered by cash on hand' source — the shortfall was absorbed by the balance sheet, not by revenue. Net loss in the chart is the total of $5,939M; the loss attributable to Fiserv was $5,941M ($2M of income went to noncontrolling interests).

takeaways.title: A non-cash reckoning
takeaways.text: The goodwill impairment does not use cash, but it formally writes down the value of past acquisitions. Excluding it and other items, adjusted operating income was $1,512M — still down from $1,822M a year ago as margins compressed.

takeaways.title: Organic revenue went flat
takeaways.text: Organic revenue was flat overall: Merchant Solutions fell 2% organically while Financial Solutions grew 2%. Fiserv affirmed its full-year outlook of -1% to 0% organic growth and $7.20–$7.40 adjusted EPS.

takeaways.title: Cost cuts are the plan
takeaways.text: Fiserv raised its 'Project Elevate' savings target from $500M to $1B after a portfolio review, sold its student-loan servicing business, and plans to resume buybacks with $500M of repurchases in Q4.

oneTimers: The $6,452M goodwill impairment is non-cash and sits in the Corporate and Other segment; GAAP operating margin was -105.7% because of it (adjusted operating margin: 31.2%).
Adjusted results also exclude $297M of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, $158M of 'One Fiserv' transformation costs and $83M of severance.
